import datetime
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, log_loss, roc_auc_score

SEED = 12345
N_FOLDS = 5

np.random.seed(SEED)

np.random.seed(SEED) # set random seed for fold assignment reproducibility

scores_frame['fold'] = np.random.choice(N_FOLDS, scores_frame.shape[0]) # assign each row to a random fold

# load three model score files to compare
for model_name, file_name in model_files.items():
    scores_frame[model_name] = pd.read_csv(file_name)['phat']

scores_frame.head()

metric_list = ['acc', 'auc', 'logloss'] # three evaluation metrics to calculate
model_names = list(model_files)         # model names
rows = []                               # init empty list to collect results rows

for fold in sorted(scores_frame['fold'].unique()):                  # loop through folds
    fold_df = scores_frame.loc[scores_frame['fold'] == fold].copy() # subset rows for current fold
    fold_y = fold_df[y_name]                                        # cache true labels for current fold

    for metric_name in metric_list:                       # loop through evaluation metrics
        row_dict = {'fold': fold, 'metric': metric_name}  # init results row for current fold and metric

        for model_name in model_names:        # loop through models
            fold_scores = fold_df[model_name] # cache this model's predictions

            if metric_name == 'acc':                                                      # accuracy
                decisions = np.where(fold_scores >= 0.5, 1, 0)                            # convert probabilities into 0/1 predictions
                row_dict[model_name] = np.round(accuracy_score(fold_y, decisions), ROUND) # compute and round

            elif metric_name == 'auc':                                                      # AUC
                row_dict[model_name] = np.round(roc_auc_score(fold_y, fold_scores), ROUND)  # compute and round

            elif metric_name == 'logloss':                                            # log loss
                row_dict[model_name] = np.round(log_loss(fold_y, fold_scores), ROUND) # compute and round

        rows.append(row_dict) # save completed row for fold and metric

eval_frame = pd.DataFrame(rows) # convert list of result rows to dataframe

rank_rows = []                        # init empty list to collect ranking rows
for _, row in eval_frame.iterrows():  # loop through fold-metric result rows
    score_series = row[model_names]   # subset model score columns for ranking

    if row['metric'] == 'logloss':                  # for log loss, lower is better
        ranks = score_series.rank()                 # rank from smallest to largest
    else:                                           # for accuracy and AUC, higher is better
        ranks = score_series.rank(ascending=False)  # rank from largest to smallest

    # store ranks
    rank_rows.append({f'{model_name}_rank': ranks[model_name] for model_name in model_names})

rank_frame = pd.DataFrame(rank_rows)                      # convert the list ranking rows to dataframe
eval_frame = pd.concat([eval_frame, rank_frame], axis=1)  # merge rank columns

eval_frame  # display results
eval_frame[[name for name in eval_frame.columns if name.endswith('_rank')]].mean().sort_values()
